name: Belonger Status -- Marriage to a Belonger

qualifying_event.description: The spouse of a Belonger may apply for Belonger status under the Immigration and Passport Ordinance after 5 years of continuous cohabitation as husband and wife.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate; proof of continuous cohabitation for 5 years; spouse's proof of Belonger status.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires marriage to a Belonger with 5 years of continuous cohabitation as husband and wife.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of continuous cohabitation with the Belonger spouse.

sources.title: Civil Registry and Immigration System of the Virgin Islands -- Belonger status: no automatic constitutional pathway via marriage, but a 5-year continuous-cohabitation route under the Immigration and Passport Ordinance, materially shorter than the 20-year Belonger-by-residence route

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the British Virgin Islands' initial build. The source is explicit that marriage to a Belonger creates NO automatic/constitutional right to Belonger status (unlike birth, descent, or adoption) -- it is instead an accelerated administrative route under the Immigration and Passport Ordinance, 5 years versus the 20-year general residence-based Belonger route (vg_belonger_status_residence.json). Modelled as a separate 'family' category file per this dataset's convention of splitting routes by category where the underlying ground differs materially from the constitutional grounds in vg_belonger_status_descent.json. Also distinct from the 'Spouses of British Overseas Territory Citizens' naturalisation fee category ($500, see vg_naturalisation_botc.json) -- that category is for a spouse naturalising directly as a BOTC, not for acquiring the separate, non-national Belonger status modelled here.
